typesense:trending.greeting:
*It is the 41st Millennium.*

*For over ten thousand years, the Imperium of Man has endured beneath the immortal gaze of the Emperor of Mankind, whose broken body rests upon the Golden Throne of Holy Terra. His will echoes across a million worlds through the light of the Astronomican, guiding humanity's vast fleets through the nightmare realm known as the Warp.*

*The galaxy burns. Hive cities rise higher than mountains while their forgotten depths drown in crime and mutation. Forge Worlds labor without rest beneath oceans of smoke and steel. Knight Worlds cling to ancient traditions. Shrine Worlds overflow with pilgrims seeking salvation. Agri Worlds feed entire sectors. Death Worlds devour those born upon them.*

*Beyond the Imperium's borders lurk horrors beyond imagination.*

*Ancient xenos empires awaken. Greenskin WAAAGHs consume entire systems. The Tyranid Hive Fleets descend like living extinction. The Necrons rise from tombs older than mankind itself. The Aeldari walk fading paths of destiny. The Drukhari prey from impossible shadows. The T'au Empire expands with quiet ambition. And the Chaos whispers from every darkness.*

*Every star may hide a battlefield. Every prayer may be unanswered. Every victory demands sacrifice. You are but one soul among untold trillions.*

*Perhaps you are a humble manufactorum laborer. A newly inducted Guardsman. An Adepta Sororitas Battle Sister. A Tech-Priest of Mars. A Rogue Trader. An Inquisitor. An Astartes. An Assassin. A Navigator. A sanctioned Psyker. A xenos.*

*Or something far stranger.*

*The galaxy does not care who you are.*

*It will remember only whether you survived.*
typesense:trending.name: Warhammer 40,000 RPG
typesense:trending.title: In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war.

title_i18n.de: In der düsteren Dunkelheit der fernen Zukunft gibt es nur Krieg.
title_i18n.fr: Dans l'obscurité sinistre du lointain futur, il n'y a que la guerre.
title_i18n.it: Nell'oscura oscurità del lontano futuro, non c'è che guerra.
title_i18n.ko: 먼 미래의 암울한 어둠 속, 오직 전쟁만이 존재한다.
title_i18n.pl: W posępnej ciemności dalekiej przyszłości jest tylko wojna.
title_i18n.ru: В мрачной тьме далёкого будущего есть только война.
title_i18n.zh: 在遥远未来的残酷黑暗中，只有战争。
